name: info
content: Connect to your **Claude Console** organization using an **Admin API key**. Create one in the [Claude Console (Settings → Admin keys)](https://platform.claude.com/settings/admin-keys). The key starts with `sk-ant-admin` and is different from a standard API key. The Admin API requires an organization (not an individual account) and an admin, owner, or primary-owner role.

name: adminApiKey
label: Admin API Key
help: Your organization's Admin API key from the [Claude Console (Settings → Admin keys)](https://platform.claude.com/settings/admin-keys). Starts with `sk-ant-admin`. Sent as the `x-api-key` header on every request.
